surveyed_zero_surface.presence: at least one pilot occurrence row with organismQuantity > 0 linked by coreid to a frozen eligible pitfall event in the island-phase
surveyed_zero_surface.absence: no such positive occurrence for an eligible pilot taxon in an island-phase; absence is permitted only because all 21 island-phases passed the frozen surveyed-zero gate

taxonomic_scope_rule.identity: MF identificationRemarks token is the focal taxon identity
taxonomic_scope_rule.consistency: each pilot MF token must map to at most one nonblank scientificName, order, family and taxonRank across its rows; conflict makes that pilot taxon ineligible
taxonomic_scope_rule.hymenoptera_rule: Hymenoptera eligible only when the unique nonblank family is Formicidae
taxonomic_scope_rule.reason: metadata state that Acari/Collembola were excluded and Diptera plus non-Formicidae Hymenoptera were not separated to stable morphospecies

three_wave_estimability_summary.t0_source_requirement: at least two occupied islands at t0 for source-loss leverage eligibility
three_wave_estimability_summary.source_loss: t0 occupied island absent at t1
three_wave_estimability_summary.downstream_target: different island occupied at t1; the lost source itself is absent at t1 and cannot be its own target
three_wave_estimability_summary.t2_contraction: target occupied at t1 and absent at t2
three_wave_estimability_summary.t2_persistence: target occupied at both t1 and t2

advance_gate.if_failed: STOP BALA confirmatory source-loss route; do not lower thresholds or alter taxon partition
advance_gate.if_passed: permit confirmatory protocol construction only; confirmatory occurrence remains sealed until t0/t1 versus t2 firewall and full prediction surface are frozen

anti_selection: do not compute source leverage in the pilot
do not fit C versus R2 in the pilot
do not inspect confirmatory rows or token identities
do not change taxonomic exclusions after pilot results
do not lower estimability thresholds after pilot results
do not choose species by interesting loss or contraction direction
